first_patch_recommendation.label: Current ordinary bottom-center right patch; local diagnostic only
required_interfaces: base_rail_bottom_right ↔ base_principal_center_right (direct butt seat; parent live geometry review reports 5322.57 mm²)
first_patch_recommendation.boundary_and_load_method: Start with all three full current timber members; treat all three physical wood interfaces as separate finite unilateral contacts, including the direct rail/principal butt seat reported as 5322.57 mm² and apply bounded unit-response wrenches. The four physical stacks have 20 source-CAD component roles, not 20 required FE bodies. No truncation or remote cut is required for the first patch. If a later model truncates the rail or principal, declare those remote cuts and run cut-distance sensitivity; freeze contact, bolt, stiffness, gap and output assumptions in the patch contract before any mesh/run.
patch_specific_unknowns: Exact current native finished faces, bores, local frames and face gaps/normals.
Member material/grain frames and current adopted properties.
Whether the chosen bounded unit-response components exercise all local patch modes without claiming complete-frame demands.
If later truncating full rail/principal members: exact remote-cut locations, constraints and sensitivity range.

For this diagnostic only, an explicit provisional material/hardware/grip scenario may be frozen before calculation; label every assumption and sensitivity, and do not treat it as selected product or criterion evidence. Product purchase is not a prerequisite to local method exploration.
limits: Does not close the complete frame load path or all 24 block duties.
Does not establish WJ-09 demand, candidate capacity, stiffness acceptance or a criterion pass.
The old `wj04_lower_full_stock_cleat` diagnostic geometry is not a proxy for these current IDs.
first_patch_recommendation.role_interpretation: These are four physical stacks × five modeled source-CAD component roles. They are not 20 required FE bodies; represent bolts/washers by the justified connector/contact formulation in the frozen patch contract.
first_patch_recommendation.scene_binding_note: Bind source hashes and identity for the full changed plus unchanged scene. This does not require meshing the full scene for the initial local patch.
first_patch_recommendation.contact_closure_note: Represent all three physical wood contacts as separate finite unilateral interfaces. Confirm the direct rail/principal butt-seat footprint and reported 5322.57 mm² area against the exact parent-frozen member shapes before meshing; do not omit or merge it with either cleat face.

complete_exterior_node_closure.scope: Whole-node follow-on only; the four transverse axes in the left/right outer sandwich do not close this path.
required_graph_edges: Each outer spine bears on its floor runner and bolts to its outer post.
Each side pair links spine, side member and inner frame block.
The inner frame block connects vertically to base_header through its two `inner_header` bolts per side.
Carry the side-to-leg and runner-to-post/leg retained bolt paths; if host segments are truncated, declare and sensitivity-test remote boundaries.
